description.true: MAXIMIZE STUDENT CAPABILITY: staged planning, concept gates, ownership negotiation, student practice, and verification.
description.false: MAXIMIZE CODE GENERATED: implement complete feature slices efficiently while preserving verification and learning documentation when configured.
description.includeTests: Boolean (default: true). Whether the project provisions, writes, and validates xUnit tests (<AppName>.Tests). When false, testManagementMode is ignored and tests are skipped.

testManagementMode.combined: (Default) Combined: Agent creates and explains tests at the end of each stage/slice, proposes selected test cases for the student to write, and documents all tests in Learning/Test-Documentation.md.
testManagementMode.agent: Agent: Agent independently writes and runs xUnit tests as part of the slice workflow and documents them in Learning/Test-Documentation.md.
testManagementMode.student: Student: Agent guides the student through a Socratic dialogue to identify required test cases and coaches the student in writing the xUnit tests.
testManagementMode.maximizeCodeOverride: When studentCapabilityMode is false (MAXIMIZE CODE GENERATED) and includeTests is true, the agent ALWAYS writes and runs all tests regardless of testManagementMode and documents them in Learning/Test-Documentation.md.
